clue.text: Lively Miss Oakley, they say, was married

indicators.note: they say tells us the sharpshooter's first name is taken by its sound only

parts.note: Annie Oakley was the famous American sharpshooter
mated means paired off or wed

explanation.surface: A remark that the spirited markswoman Annie Oakley had a husband.
explanation.walkthrough: Annie Oakley was the American sharpshooter of Wild West shows; only her first name is used, and only for its sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone full of life and movement is described as lively.

clue.text: A rich man's jewels

parts.note: Bill Gates, the Microsoft founder, is a byword for a very rich man

explanation.surface: A wealthy person's collection of gems.
explanation.definitionFit: Agates are banded semi-precious stones, so they are a kind of jewel.

clue.text: Examples of incessant manoeuvres

indicators.note: manoeuvres says the letters of the next word are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: Cases illustrating constant shifting about.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: instances are cases or examples of something.

clue.text: Jenny consumed by deep depression

indicators.note: consumed means the word for a jenny swallows up the small word that follows

parts.note: a jenny is a female donkey, i.e. an ass

explanation.surface: A female donkey falls into a gloomy mood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'consumed by' looks like a passive phrase; in fact the small word itself is what the female donkey swallows.
explanation.definitionFit: A chasm or bottomless pit is a very deep hollow, a depression in the ground.

clue.text: Some fear a chest pain

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone anxious about chest pain.
explanation.definitionFit: An ache in the ear is a specific kind of pain.

clue.text: A ring that's a symbol of love

definitions.meaning: the figure zero is drawn as a ring shape
in tennis scoring love means zero, written as the figure 0

explanation.surface: A ring given as a token of romance.
explanation.definitionFit: The figure for zero is a circle, and zero is love in tennis scoring.

clue.text: Recovering macho types don't (surprisingly) go outside

indicators.note: go outside means the shuffled letters wrap round the word for macho types
surprisingly signals the letters of the word before are jumbled

parts.note: he-men are tough, macho men

explanation.surface: Tough guys getting better refuse to leave the house, oddly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surprisingly' turns DONT into ONT...D, which goes outside HEMEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a patient who is recovering is said to be getting better again.

clue.text: Visitor supposed to be heard

indicators.note: to be heard means we want the word that sounds like the clue word

parts.note: supposed means guessed

explanation.surface: A caller who is meant to be listened to.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a guest is someone who visits your home.

clue.text: Utmost nerve required by senior command

parts.note: top means highest or utmost
brass means cheek or nerve

explanation.surface: The generals need supreme courage.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the top brass are the highest-ranking officers in charge.

clue.text: Like a crime writer, they test for quality

parts.note: as means like
Dorothy L. Sayers wrote the Lord Peter Wimsey detective novels

explanation.surface: People who, like a mystery novelist, try out how good things are.
explanation.definitionFit: Assayers analyse metals and ores to establish their purity.

clue.text: Oscar winner looks to make a comeback — about time!

indicators.note: about means the reversed word goes round the letter for time
to make a comeback means the word for looks is turned back to front

parts.note: peers means looks closely

explanation.surface: An Academy Award star seeks a return to the screen at long last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to make a comeback' turns PEERS into SREEP, which goes 'about' T.
explanation.definitionFit: Meryl Streep has won several Academy Awards for acting.

clue.text: Donor card held by a killer? On the contrary!

indicators.note: held by would put the donor card inside the killer, which the phrase after it flips
on the contrary reverses the relation, so the killer is held in the donor card words

explanation.surface: A murderer carrying an organ donation card, or rather the card holding the murderer.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally, the donor card is inside the killer; 'On the contrary' swaps that, so the killer sits inside 'Donor card'.
explanation.definitionFit: The orca is called the killer whale, a fierce marine predator.

clue.text: A male involved in weird sex tests

indicators.note: involved in means put inside the jumbled letters
weird signals the letters of the next word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man caught up in strange sexual trials.
explanation.walkthrough: 'weird' turns SEX into EXS, and AM goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: exams are formal tests of knowledge.

clue.text: Pop in after fish and chips

indicators.note: after puts the phrase for popping in behind the fish

parts.note: a carp is a freshwater fish
to pop in is to enter

explanation.surface: Drop by once you have had your fish supper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fish and chips' looks like a British takeaway meal; 'Chips' is a traditional nickname for a carpenter, from wood chips.
explanation.definitionFit: Chips is a traditional nickname for a woodworker, from the shavings of the trade.

clue.text: A company reported what interest payments do

indicators.note: reported means the phrase is said aloud and spelt as it sounds

parts.note: a crew is a company of people working together

explanation.surface: A firm said to be doing what interest does.
explanation.definitionFit: Interest builds up over time; it accumulates or grows.

clue.text: The Queen loves to cook for the president

indicators.note: to cook something is to tamper with it, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the standard abbreviation for the Queen

explanation.surface: Her Majesty enjoys making meals for the head of state.
explanation.definitionFit: Both Theodore and Franklin D. Roosevelt were US presidents.

clue.text: Programmes featuring a tale from the east about death

indicators.note: about means the reversed tale goes round the word for death
from the east means read right to left, so the word for tale is backwards

parts.note: a saga is a long tale
end means death

explanation.surface: Schedules including a story from the Orient about dying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the east' turns SAGA into AGAS, which goes 'about' END.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: agendas are lists of things to be done, programmes of business.

clue.text: In which the setter, perhaps, must face the judges

definitions.text: In which the setter, perhaps, must face the judges

parts.words: In which the setter, perhaps, must face the judges
parts.note: the setter here is a breed of gun dog, not the puzzle compiler, competing before judges

explanation.surface: The crossword compiler is up before the bench.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setter' seems to be the crossword's own author; it is a breed of gun dog, judged in field contests.
explanation.definitionFit: Competitions where working dogs such as setters are tested and assessed by judges.

clue.text: US general keeps order — he's never wrong

indicators.note: keeps means the general's name holds the abbreviation inside it

parts.note: George Custer was the US general of the Little Bighorn
OM is the Order of Merit

explanation.surface: An American commander maintains discipline and is infallible.
explanation.definitionFit: From the saying that the shopper is always right.

clue.text: Results of aiming too high?

definitions.meaning: shots fired too high are, playfully, shots going up

explanation.surface: The outcome of overambition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: outcomes are results; and playfully, a shot aimed high goes up.

clue.text: Become fit

definitions.meaning: to become someone is to look good on them, as a colour does
to fit is to be right or appropriate for

explanation.definitionFit: A colour that flatters you matches you well; to be appropriate is the same verb.

clue.text: Blond Belgian regularly selected in Spanish store

indicators.note: regularly selected means take every other letter of the two words

explanation.surface: A fair-haired Belgian is often chosen in a Spanish shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A bodega is a Spanish wine shop or small grocery.

clue.text: Signs of growth about to become chancellor's main concern

indicators.note: about means the word for signs of growth goes round the word for become

parts.note: buds are the first signs of a plant's growth
get means become, as in get wet

explanation.surface: Green shoots are about to become the finance minister's priority.
explanation.walkthrough: The Chancellor of the Exchequer is the UK finance minister, who presents the annual budget.
explanation.definitionFit: The annual financial statement is what a finance minister chiefly works on.

clue.text: Humble clergyman takes me to his heart

indicators.note: takes means the clergyman receives the following word within
to his heart says the word goes into the middle of the clergyman

parts.note: a dean is a senior clergyman

explanation.surface: A modest priest embraces me warmly.
explanation.definitionFit: To humble someone is to lower their dignity, a verb sense matching this one.

clue.text: Business spiral shipowners once relied on

parts.note: trade means business or commerce
to wind is to coil or spiral

explanation.surface: A commercial downturn that old shipping firms depended on.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailing ships relied on steady tropical winds for their routes.

clue.text: A Liberal Democrat joins in freely

indicators.note: joins in means the letter for Democrat is placed in among the other pieces

explanation.surface: A Lib Dem politician takes part without restraint.
explanation.definitionFit: An ad lib remark is made spontaneously and freely, without a script.

clue.text: Look around Central American nest site

indicators.note: around means the word for look wraps round the middle letters

parts.note: eye means look at

indicators.note: central means take the middle letters of the next word

explanation.surface: Scanning for a nesting spot in Central America.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyrie is the nest of an eagle or other bird of prey.

clue.text: Musical key almost essential

parts.note: E is a musical key

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is dropped from the word for essential

parts.note: vital means essential

explanation.surface: A show tune's key is nearly indispensable.
explanation.definitionFit: Evita is the Lloyd Webber and Rice stage show about Eva Perón.

clue.text: Gentle tailless sheep with fungal growth

parts.note: mild means gentle

indicators.note: tailless means the final letter of the word for sheep is lost

parts.note: a ewe is a female sheep

explanation.surface: A docile sheep with no tail and a fungus.
explanation.definitionFit: Mildew is a thin whitish fungus growing on damp surfaces and plants.

clue.text: Single cable tie comes loose

indicators.note: comes loose suggests the letters of the tie break apart and reform

explanation.surface: One cable tie unfastens.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone celibate abstains from marriage and sex, so is single.

clue.text: Argue with king not duke for price reduction

indicators.note: with king says the letter for king is brought in
not duke says the letter for duke is taken away and replaced

parts.note: debate means argue
R, for rex, is an abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Dispute with the monarch rather than the nobleman over a discount.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebate is a partial refund or reduction in an amount paid.

clue.text: Stupid pair join in, naming the killer

indicators.note: pair means the word for a stupid person appears twice

parts.note: an ass is a stupid person

explanation.surface: Two fools join a group in identifying the murderer.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is someone who murders, typically a prominent person.
